gadgets.name: The Bellows
gadgets.behaviour: Cone gust, 6 u long, 50 deg wide, fires in the facing direction (aim up/down 45 deg). Instant. 18 f between puffs.
gadgets.counterplay: Guard halves the push and keeps your feet planted. Parry sends the gust back at 1.3x. Stay grounded: airborne fighters fly 1.6x further.
gadgets.beat: Three people leaving the island like leaves off a lawn. Also the cheapest recovery in the game: puff downward to hop.

gadgets.name: Plunger-on-a-String
gadgets.behaviour: Fires a plunger 9 u at 22 u/s. Sticks to the first fighter, chunk, rubble or gadget. Press Use again within 3 s to yank: light targets fly to you at 18 u/s; heavier or fixed targets pull YOU to them.
gadgets.counterplay: Parry it and it sticks to the shooter's face: you get the yank. Any hit on the string cuts it. Grog is too heavy to be yanked: he reels you in instead.
gadgets.beat: Yank a friend toward you, sidestep, watch them sail past and off the far edge.

gadgets.name: The Vintage
gadgets.behaviour: Champagne bottle. Hold Use to shake (up to 45 f), release to fire the cork at 34 u/s. The recoil launches the shooter the other way.
gadgets.counterplay: It is loud and slow: jump or parry (the cork comes back). The shooter is airborne and helpless for 20 f afterwards.
gadgets.beat: The recoil kills the shooter as often as the target. Aim it at the floor to rocket-jump back from the dead.

gadgets.name: Pepper Mill
gadgets.behaviour: Grinds a pepper cloud 3 u wide, lasting 4 s. Anyone inside (the user too) for 40 f builds a sneeze, then sneezes: launched BACKWARDS from the way they face.
gadgets.counterplay: Leave the cloud, or turn your back to the island centre so the sneeze throws you inward. Bellows and Snort blow the cloud around.
gadgets.beat: Ah... ah... CHOO. An ornament rocketing backwards off the island with a tiny sneeze.

gadgets.name: Pop-Up Toaster
gadgets.behaviour: Place it on the ground. 36 f after anyone (or anything) lands on it: DING, straight up at 26 u/s. Three pops, then it is a throwable brick.
gadgets.counterplay: It ticks for 36 f: step off. Hit it to knock it away. Jam on top of it stops it firing.
gadgets.beat: The ding. Then somebody who was winning is above the camera.

gadgets.name: Jam Jar
gadgets.behaviour: Lob it: it splats into a puddle 3 u wide for 8 s. Fighters in it are rooted (can attack and guard, cannot walk or jump) until they press Jump 3 times or 90 f pass. Rubble and gadgets stick too.
gadgets.counterplay: Mash Jump. Guard still works while stuck. The puddle falls with its chunk.
gadgets.beat: Being glued to a piece of island at the exact moment that piece stops being island.

gadgets.name: Egg Timer
gadgets.behaviour: Press Use: you snap back to where you were 120 f ago, with the damage you have now. Leaves a ticking ghost where you will return to. Usable in hitstun.
gadgets.counterplay: Everyone can see the ghost: stand on it with a heavy attack ready, or break the chunk under it.
gadgets.beat: Launched, rewound, saved. Or: rewinding onto a chunk that fell off a second ago.

gadgets.name: The Hoover
gadgets.behaviour: Hold Use: suction cone 5 u, pulls fighters at 9 u/s, rubble and gadgets at 16 u/s. A fighter who reaches the nozzle is bagged for up to 90 f, then fired in the aim direction as a living projectile.
gadgets.counterplay: Guard resists the pull. Mash inside the bag to cut it to 40 f. The user cannot guard while sucking. Grog cannot be bagged.
gadgets.beat: Firing one friend at another friend.

gadgets.name: Horseshoe Magnet
gadgets.behaviour: Tap Use: for 60 f every loose object within 8 u (rubble, gadgets, shells, bobbers, corks) flies to the holder and orbits. Tap again: all of it fires outward in the aim direction as shrapnel. Fighters are ceramic and do not stick, but their held gadgets are ripped away.
gadgets.counterplay: Useless on a clean stage: deny it rubble. Parry reflects each piece of shrapnel. Hold your gadget out of range or lose it.
gadgets.beat: A cloud of crockery, a held breath, then all of it going one direction.
